description: Parallel correctness + security review of the working-tree diff, then one synthesized, de-duplicated report.

tasks.prompt: Review the current working-tree changes for CORRECTNESS. Run `git diff` (and `git diff --staged`) to see them, then report bugs, risky edits, and concrete improvements — specific, cited as path:line, ordered by severity. If there are no changes, say so. {{input}}

Review the current working-tree changes for SECURITY. Run `git diff` (and `git diff --staged`) to see them, then look for injection (shell/SQL/path), secret exposure, missing authz, unsafe deserialization, SSRF, and unvalidated input reaching a sink — each with path:line, the risk, and a fix. If there's no security-relevant surface, say so. {{input}}

Combine the two reviews below into ONE prioritized report: de-duplicate overlapping findings, order most-severe first, keep every path:line citation, and drop noise. Output only the report.

{{previous}}
